questions.nukte_en: Jitter = uneven delay in packet arrival -> distorted audio/video playback.
questions.nukte_hi: Jitter = packet पहुँचने में uneven delay -> audio/video playback ख़राब हो जाती है।

C: Synchronization is about aligning data, not the variation in arrival time.
Synchronization data ko align karne ke baare mein hai, arrival time ke antar ke nahi।
D: Encoding is converting data into a suitable form, not a delay variation.
Encoding data ko suitable form mein badalna hai, delay ka antar nahi।

questions.stem_en: Which physical topology offers the highest robustness (fault tolerance) because of multiple redundant paths, but is also the most expensive and hardest to install because of the huge amount of cabling?
questions.stem_hi: कौन सी physical topology सबसे ज़्यादा robust (fault tolerant) है क्योंकि ismein कई redundant paths होते हैं, लेकिन सबसे महंगी और install करने में सबसे मुश्किल भी है क्योंकि बहुत ज़्यादा cabling चाहिए?
questions.explanation_en: Mesh has a dedicated link between every pair of devices, so the failure of one link does not affect the others - it is the most robust. But n(n-1)/2 links make it the most expensive and hardest to install/wire.
questions.explanation_hi: Mesh में हर pair of devices के बीच dedicated link होता है, इसलिए एक link fail होने से दूसरे affected नहीं होते - यह सबसे robust है। लेकिन n(n-1)/2 links की वजह से यह सबसे महंगी और install करने में सबसे मुश्किल है।
questions.nukte_en: Mesh = most robust + most costly (n(n-1)/2 cables). Star = cheap & easy but hub is a single point of failure. Bus = cheapest, hardest fault isolation.
questions.nukte_hi: Mesh = सबसे robust + सबसे महंगी (n(n-1)/2 cables). Star = sasti और आसान लेकिन hub single point of failure है. Bus = सबसे sasti, fault isolation सबसे मुश्किल.

A: Bus is cheap, but a backbone break stops everything - least robust.
Bus sasti hai, lekin backbone tootne se sab kuch band ho jata hai - sabse kam robust.
B: Ring: failure of one link/device can bring down the loop - not the most robust.
Ring: ek link/device fail hone se poora loop band ho sakta hai - sabse robust nahi.
C: Star depends on the central hub - a single point of failure, not the most robust.
Star central hub par nirbhar hai - single point of failure, sabse robust nahi.

questions.stem_en: Four network segments in Bus topology are: A1–A2, B1–B2–B3, C1–C2 and D1–D2–D3. If A1, B1, C1 and D1 are interconnected in a mesh, how many mesh connections are required?
questions.stem_hi: Bus topology में चार network segments हैं: A1–A2, B1–B2–B3, C1–C2 और D1–D2–D3। यदि A1, B1, C1 और D1 को mesh में जोड़ा जाए, तो कितने mesh connections चाहिए?
questions.explanation_en: Only the four interconnecting nodes (A1, B1, C1, D1) are meshed: links = n(n-1)/2 = 4×3/2 = 6. (Matches the official RPSC key.)
questions.explanation_hi: सिर्फ चार interconnecting nodes (A1, B1, C1, D1) mesh हो रहे हैं: links = n(n-1)/2 = 4×3/2 = 6। (Official RPSC key से match.)
questions.nukte_en: Mesh formula n(n-1)/2 — लेकिन n सिर्फ meshed nodes है (4), पूरे network के hosts (10) नहीं!
questions.nukte_hi: Mesh formula n(n-1)/2 — पर n सिर्फ meshed nodes है (4), पूरे network के hosts (10) नहीं!

A: 12 = 4×3 = n(n-1) — each link counted twice.
12 = 4×3 = n(n-1) — हर link दो बार गिना गया।
B: 10 is the total number of hosts in the four segments — but only 4 nodes are being meshed.
10 चारों segments के कुल hosts हैं — पर सिर्फ 4 nodes mesh हो रहे हैं।
D: 45 = 10×9/2 — that would mesh ALL 10 hosts; the question meshes only A1, B1, C1, D1.
45 = 10×9/2 — इसमें सभी 10 hosts mesh होंगे; प्रश्न में सिर्फ A1, B1, C1, D1 mesh हैं।

questions.nukte_hi: LANs का full mesh = n(n-1)/2 WAN links। Formula mesh जैसा ही है।

A: n links only forms a ring/star-like interconnection — not direct pairwise connectivity.
n links से ring/star जैसा interconnection बनता है — हर युग्म की सीधी connectivity नहीं।
B: n-1 links form a spanning tree — some LANs would reach others only through a third LAN.

D: n² counts ordered pairs including self-pairs; the correct count is n(n-1)/2.

questions.stem_en:
Consider the following statements regarding the slow start phase of TCP congestion control (cwnd = congestion window, MSS = maximum segment size):
(i) cwnd increases by 2 MSS on every successful acknowledgement.
(ii) cwnd approximately doubles on every successful acknowledgement.
(iii) cwnd increases by 1 MSS every round trip time.
(iv) cwnd approximately doubles every round trip time.
Which one of the following is correct?
questions.stem_hi:
TCP congestion control के slow start चरण (cwnd = congestion window, MSS = maximum segment size) के बारे में विचार कीजिए:
(i) हर successful acknowledgement पर cwnd 2 MSS बढ़ता है।
(ii) हर successful acknowledgement पर cwnd लगभग दोगुना होता है।
(iii) हर round trip time में cwnd 1 MSS बढ़ता है।
(iv) हर round trip time में cwnd लगभग दोगुना होता है।
क्या सही है?
questions.explanation_en: Slow start mein har ACK par cwnd 1 MSS badhta hai; RTT mein cwnd/MSS ACKs aate hain — isliye per RTT cwnd double hota hai: sirf (iv) sahi hai.
questions.explanation_hi: Slow start में हर ACK पर cwnd +1 MSS; एक RTT में cwnd/MSS ACKs — इसलिए per RTT double: केवल (iv) सही।
questions.nukte_en: Per-ACK doubling (ii) bahut tez hota; (iii) per-RTT sirf 1 MSS congestion avoidance jaisa hai.
questions.nukte_hi: Per-ACK doubling (ii) असंभव-सा; (iii) तो congestion avoidance जैसा।

questions.stem_en:
Consider the following three statements about link state and distance vector routing protocols for a large network with 500 nodes and 4000 links:
S1: The computational overhead in link state protocols is higher than in distance vector protocols.
S2: A distance vector protocol (with split horizon) avoids persistent routing loops, but a link state protocol does not.
S3: After a topology change, a link state protocol converges faster than a distance vector protocol.
Which one is correct?
questions.stem_hi:
500 nodes और 4000 links वाले बड़े network के लिए link state व distance vector routing protocols के बारे में तीन कथन:
S1: Link state में computational overhead distance vector से अधिक है।
S2: Distance vector (split horizon सहित) persistent loops से बचता है, पर link state नहीं।
S3: Topology बदलने पर link state, distance vector से तेज़ converge करता है।
कौन-सा सही है?
options_en: S1, S2 and S3 are all true
S1, S2 and S3 are all false
S1 and S2 are true, S3 is false
S1 and S3 are true, S2 is false
options_hi: S1 और S2 सही, S3 गलत
S1 और S3 सही, S2 गलत
questions.explanation_en: S1 sahi: har node poora SPF/Dijkstra chalata hai. S3 sahi: flooding se LS topology turant jaanti hai. S2 galat: link state shortest-path tree loop-free hota hai — loops ki samasya distance vector ki hai.
questions.explanation_hi: S1 सही: हर node पूरा SPF चलाता है। S3 सही: flooding से तेज़ converge। S2 गलत: link state tree loop-free होता है।
questions.nukte_en: S2 ulta hai — split horizon count-to-infinity se poora bachata bhi nahi.
questions.nukte_hi: S2 उल्टा — split horizon count-to-infinity से पूरा बचाता भी नहीं।
